long_description:
Ten years of RRB, one unforgettable night. 🪔

RRB Dance Company is turning 10, and we're celebrating Navratri with our biggest Garba Night yet: The All-White Affair. Whether you've danced Garba your whole life or this is your first time, this night is for you. Bring your family, your friends, your dance crew, or your whole group. Everyone is welcome on the floor.

What to expect:
We start with traditional Garba and Raas, then pick up the dandiya sticks for Dandiya. After that, DJ Aaryan takes over for a Bollywood dance party to close out the night. Expect great music, festive energy, and a room full of people dressed in white.

Dress code
White is encouraged but optional. Come in your favorite white chaniya choli, kurta, or anything that feels festive. It makes for amazing photos.

Schedule
8:00 PM Doors open, Garba and Raas begin
Dandiya follows
Bollywood Night with DJ Aaryan
9:30 PM Event ends

Tickets
General Admission: $20 per person
Group of 10: $120 total
Kids 5 and under: Free

Grab your tickets early. Group tickets are the best deal if you're coming with friends or family.

Food and extras
Food, drinks, and dandiya sticks will be available for purchase at the event. No need to bring your own sticks.

Location and parking
RRB Studios, 10749 South St, Cerritos, CA 90703
Free parking on site.

Also check out other Kids events & activities in Cerritos.
